2TheMoon

From learning how neural networks work to exploring the hardware that could train them.

SystemVerilog · Hardware design · Planned C/C++ interface

View source on GitHub ↗

The idea

After Choom, I wanted to understand AI computing hardware. I began with a concept involving 4×4 matrix registers and a multiply-accumulate unit, then expanded the design toward a larger tensor-processing system.

Current work

Implementation has started on a 256×256 matrix register, organized into 4×4 sections. The design also calls for storage for model weights. There is no working demo or interface yet. I spend approximately four hours a week on the project.

Planned direction

The hardware is being developed in SystemVerilog, with a planned C/C++ interface. I intend to integrate stock data through an API for simulation and model training, and eventually explore stock-value prediction. These are research goals, not demonstrated trading results.
